prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1454; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, we'll note that you've been identified. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was on the access road near the shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas, going toward the highway.
Q: Were you the driver of the vehicle you were operating at the time?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car.
Q: Walk me through what happened.
A: I was moving over one lane to make my exit. I checked my mirror and saw nothing right beside me, so I signaled and started to merge. Then I felt a bump and heard scraping along the right side of my car. The other vehicle had been in my blind spot and was coming up on my side.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: No, I didn't see it until after we touched. I wish I had looked over my shoulder one more time.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes, my lower back. I felt a sharp pull when I turned to look at the damage, and it has been sore since.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They said it looked like a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain?
A: Yes, it's better in the mornings but stiff after sitting for a while. Lifting is hard right now.
Q: Did anyone else in your vehicle get hurt?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm willing to cooperate fully and provide any records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
